core_competencies.name: Metric definition
core_competencies.description: Defines numerator, denominator, grain, segmentation, time window, and decision use.

core_competencies.name: Data trust
core_competencies.description: Validates data quality, joins, lineage, anomalies, and uncertainty before recommending action.

core_competencies.name: Decision translation
core_competencies.description: Turns analysis into business, product, customer, or operational decisions.

core_competencies.name: Stakeholder communication
core_competencies.description: Explains caveats and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Defines the metric and why it matters.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Uses vague metric names without definition.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How exactly is this metric calculated?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Checks source reliability, transformations, and confounders.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What could make this result misleading?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Chooses segmentation, experiment, causal, or diagnostic method suited to the problem.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Only describes a query or chart.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How would you isolate the driver?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Connects findings to a decision and next step.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Produces analysis with no action implication.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What should the stakeholder do with this finding?
